summary: Careful, preregistered paired evaluation of a generate→validate→repair (guarded) pipeline vs a baseline single‑shot LLM generator on a 1000‑task synthetic NetOps corpus under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Execution artifacts are complete and consistent. Primary preregistered McNemar test did not reach α=0.05 (p=0.0625); a preregistered bootstrap percentile 95% CI [0.001,0.01] is reported as a secondary descriptive summary. The manuscript documents preregistration fidelity, shared_initial_candidate design, validator behavior (5 repairs), and provides full execution/analysis artifacts and required master‑prompt provenance.
critical_issues: The manuscript reports a preregistered exact McNemar confirmatory test (p=0.0625, not significant) while also presenting a preregistered bootstrap percentile 95% CI that excludes zero. The paper must more clearly and explicitly reconcile these two preregistered summaries and not allow the bootstrap CI to be read as contradicting the preregistered confirmatory null‑result; the justification must be methodological and must cite the archived analysis artifacts (no new experiments).

References and citation formatting are not verifiable in the provided manuscript prose: the paper must ensure the References section is a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography containing full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) for every cited record (do not leave bare DOI/arXiv/identifier‑only entries in the References). This is required by the venue and by the review instructions.

The Disclosure Statement contains required provenance (master prompt SHA‑256) but includes language that risks repeating execution‑log level accounting. Condense the Disclosure Statement so it lists only the required items (LLMs/models, orchestration/validator, initial master prompt reference + SHA‑256, pre‑lock human constraints vs post‑lock autonomy, preregistration identifier and assertion that preregistration preceded model calls, and statement that no human edited manuscript technical content after lock) and avoid duplicating execution logs, per‑file hashes, or provider‑call accounting in the manuscript body.
required_revisions: Add a clear, self‑contained Methods/Statistics paragraph that (a) states the exact preregistered primary inferential procedure (exact two‑sided McNemar), (b) states that the bootstrap percentile CI was a preregistered secondary descriptive summary (not the primary confirmatory test), and (c) explains—using the archived analysis artifacts—why sparse discordant counts (n10=5, n01=0) can yield an exact test p>0.05 while a nonparametric bootstrap percentile interval may exclude zero (cite the executor log and bootstrap seed/resamples preserved in artifacts). Explicitly label the bootstrap CI as descriptive/exploratory and avoid asserting confirmatory significance based on it.

Replace or augment the current CI presentation with an analysis‑method clarification referencing a preexisting exact conditional/confidence interval approach appropriate for McNemar‑type paired binary data (or explicitly state that the preregistered exact test is primary and that no confirmatory CI was computed under that exact conditional framework). Use only artifacts already archived for any additional numeric summaries or add a short explanation (no new runs).

Ensure the References section uses conventional IEEE‑numbered bibliography entries with full bibliographic metadata for every cited work. If the archived BibTeX contains complete metadata, update the manuscript References accordingly; if any cited record lacks complete metadata in the archived bibliography, replace the identifier‑only entry with the verified primary bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) available in the verification record. Do not leave DOI/arXiv/identifier‑only lines in the References.

Condense and edit the Disclosure Statement to the concise mandated content list: declared model(s) and provider, orchestration/validator names, the immutable initial master‑prompt locator + SHA‑256 (preserve exactly), preregistration identifier and statement it preceded model calls, the research‑director topic constraint vs post‑lock autonomy assertion, and a short assertion that no human manually edited technical manuscript content post‑lock. Remove execution‑log level accounting, per‑file hashes, and repeated numeric execution summaries from the Disclosure Statement (those belong in the archived artifact bundle).
optional_revisions: Add a short explanatory sentence in Discussion noting alternative small‑sample paired inference approaches (e.g., mid‑p adjustment or Newcombe/Agresti‑Coull‑style intervals) and why the chosen exact test was retained as primary; this is optional but would help readers interpret the sparse‑discordant regime.

Include a brief, explicit sentence quantifying that only five repairs were invoked and discuss whether this reflects validator sensitivity, low baseline failure prevalence in the corpus, or conservative repair triggers—link to representative validator traces in the artifact bundle for interested readers.

If space permits, add a one‑line note in Methods explicitly pointing to the archived model_configuration.json (path and artifact hash already in the bundle) and reiterating that temperature=null/unset in the archived record does not imply temperature=0 sampling; keep full hashes out of manuscript prose except the single required master‑prompt SHA‑256 (already present).
